event_type.description: Icon/category hint; defaults to generic when omitted

source.description: Short source label such as ci/cd or alertmanager

external_id.description: Idempotency key used to update an existing event

links.description: Labeled links. URLs may be relative or use http, https, mailto, or tel protocols; server validation is authoritative.

link.description: Legacy single-link URL. Prefer links[]. URLs may be relative or use http, https, mailto, or tel protocols; server validation is authoritative.

team_id.description: Team ID or team name; can also be passed as ?team_id=

channels.description: Channel names or IDs; omit for team-wide events

environment.description: Short environment label such as production or staging

expires_at.description: Unix millisecond timestamp used as presentation metadata only

pinned.description: Whether the event should be treated as pinned/active in the UI

resolved_at.description: Unix millisecond timestamp marking resolution metadata

url.description: Relative URL or http, https, mailto, or tel URL; server validation is authoritative for protocols.
